response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.cnt - c.a) AS avg_excess FROM side_counts s CROSS JOIN avg_c c WHERE s.cnt > c.a

assumptions.assumption: Sides are the distinct dealedge values among matched orders; sides with no matched orders are not included in the average. Orders with NULL dealedge form their own group and count as a side.
Orders are identified by recordvault (the unique order reference); the average is the unweighted mean of per-side counts.
